app.title: GramArogya Connect
app.tagline: Rural Public Healthcare Access and Coordination Platform
app.subtitle: Connecting rural Maharashtra villages to primary health centres, community hospitals, and coordinated medical care.

common.tryAdjusting: Try adjusting your search criteria or clearing filters.
common.demoNotice: Notice: This is a frontend demonstration using synthetic data. No real hospital records or government servers are contacted.

home.welcome: Coordinated Public Healthcare for Rural Maharashtra
home.heroDesc: Empowering citizens, ASHA workers, and public health centres across Maharashtra talukas with transparent facility discovery, appointment requests, and clinical referral coordination.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search by facility name, village, or PIN code (e.g. Wagholi, Shirur, 412207)...

quickActions.findFacilityDesc: Locate verified Sub-Centres, PHCs, CHCs, and District Hospitals in your taluka.
quickActions.requestApptDesc: Schedule an outpatient consultation to minimize waiting times at local health centres.
quickActions.trackReferralDesc: Monitor doctor-initiated transfers from village centres to higher-tier specialist hospitals.
quickActions.healthInfoDesc: Access guidance on maternal health, child immunization, and primary care protocols.

home.step1Desc: Search nearby public healthcare centres and check available services and operating hours.
home.step2Desc: Submit an outpatient appointment request with your symptoms and preferred time.
home.step3Desc: Receive care at your village PHC, or get seamlessly transferred to tertiary hospitals if needed.
home.featuredSubtitle: Sample healthcare institutions across Maharashtra districts (Demonstration Data)
home.maternalCare: Maternal & Child Health: Regular antenatal checkups and institutional delivery coordination.
home.immunization: National Immunization: Complete vaccination schedules for infants and mothers.
home.surveillance: Disease Surveillance: Early reporting of seasonal fever, dengue, and waterborne illnesses.
